description: This file defines a Java interface for removing product images within a CMS module. It extends a common ImageRemove interface and provides method signatures for removing individual or all images associated with a product.

classes.name: ProductImageRemove
classes.description: An interface extending ImageRemove with methods for removing product images.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a specific ProductImage, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a given Product, potentially throwing a ServiceException.
